name: sbc-godaddy-deployment-root
description: GoDaddy Node.js entry point for SBC Command Center release package

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['server.js','package.json','package-lock.json']) if(!fs.existsSync(p)) { console.error('Missing '+p); process.exit(1); } console.log('SBC deployment root files verified');"
